fasaha 1.1.0 — Major update adding register and tone control for Arabic output.

- Introduces a built-in register profile (voice-profile.md) for managing MSA vs Darija choice and tone alongside linguistic correction.
- Adds a formal review and correction workflow based on QALB guidelines, split into clear checklist steps.
- Expands scope to proactively check and improve all longer Arabic outputs, not just on user request.
- Provides a glossary, checklist, and accumulating failure log to improve consistency and transparency.
- Clarifies separation between structural/linguistic correction (fasaha) and style/voice (which can be layered on).
- Explicitly covers root error categories: Latin-script leakage, sentence-structure calque, terminology, morphology, punctuation, and dialectal interference.
